answer: Ten fakes cost 2,625 POA and five hands; one honest painter pays 60. At dawn, forty canyons open for a 30-minute pigment survey: each claimant mixes one block-seeded pigment batch and paints a mark no batch can repeat. Entry locks 60 POA, +45 per extra identity from one root. Each mark needs two stranger witnesses, at most two canyons each. One operator paints at most two canyons, so ten fakes need five hands, ten paintings, twenty witnesses. A missed mark burns 25; one batch at two canyons burns both bonds. Paint times match funding roots, so ten canyons behind one hand collapse into one.
